locked.description: Set by DevOS when the filter is enabled system-wide: the user cannot switch it off or make it less strict.

enabled.description: Default on/off state when not locked.

mode.description: women: blur body regions matched to a face estimated as an adult woman. people: blur detected person regions.

femaleThreshold.description: Female classification threshold (default 0.75; values below 0.65 are ignored to avoid broad uncertain matches).
